FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(MALAYSIA-SINGAPORE SECOND CROSSING BRIDGE AND EXPRESSWAY

AND PERLING EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of

the Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Malaysia-Singapore Second Crossing Bridge and Expressway

and Perling Expressway) (Amendment) Order 2016.

(2) This Order deemed to have come into operation on 12 January 2012.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Malaysia-Singapore Second Crossing Bridge and Expressway and Perling Expressway)

Order 1998 [P.U. (A) 97/1998], which in this Order is referred to as the

"principal Order", is amended in subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "Linkedua (Malaysia) Berhad" the words

"Projek Lebuh Raya Usahasama Berhad";

(b) by substituting for the words "1 May 2005 to 31 December 2038" the

words "12 January 2012 to 31 December 2038"; and

(c) by substituting for the words "Part I to V of the Second Schedule according

to the concession years" the words "Second Schedule".

."
